features.Name: GX frame serial
features.Description: Advances at completion of a GX render frame; interpolated/replayed frames are included. Not simulation frames or FPS.

features.Name: GX selected program
features.Description: Current/last GX shader-program selector, not a whole-scene shader.

features.Name: GX state and clear requests
features.Description: Sampled current render-frame state-application/clear counter; not draw calls, triangles or completed-frame totals.

features.Name: GX constant-buffer retries
features.Description: Draw state upload exhausted the constant arena and retried after a flush; resets at render-frame begin.

features.Name: GX vertex-buffer retries
features.Description: Transient vertex allocation exhausted its arena and retried after a flush; resets at render-frame begin.

features.Name: GX replay mode
features.Description: Renderer command replay/interpolation mode sampled at this instant.

features.Name: GX current fog flag
features.Description: Per-primitive desired fog flag; many shaders ignore it. A diagnostic, not a global fog switch.

features.Name: GX gamma exponent
features.Description: Current inverseGamma applied by final presentation shader.

features.Name: GX color-vision type
features.Description: Current final presentation constant;0disables color-vision correction.

features.Name: GX color-vision severity
features.Description: Current final presentation constant; native enabled setting clamps1..10.

prerequisites: Exact supported executable build and normal bridge lifetime gates.
Never call 11C150 to initialize for telemetry. Fixed GX = base+0x8A0970; validate readable memory for the required scalar fields (largest proposed offset 58244+4).

Require exact GX vtable base+0x5A9028, nonnull D3D device at +736 and root signature at +1144, and valid bridge/game thread for snapshot. Only read static GX scalar fields; do not dereference COM objects.
Validate each value range and finite float; publish unsupported/invalid when initialization checks fail.

Fields can change on renderer workers. Each scalar is a sampled diagnostic; reading frame serial before/after does not prove a coherent capture because replay/end paths can mutate fields between phases. Do not compare mixed samples as completed frame statistics.
Use the normal c.sceneReady gate for initial release; no graphics command calls.
excluded: No simple global NoFog or Fullbright: GS packets/per-material constants overwrite them. Need a proven render-thread interception/restore boundary and replay handling.
No wireframe native option identified: PSO creator hardcodesSOLID, cache key does not encode fillmode. Would require a designed pipeline substitution/cache policy.
No HUD-only selector established:2Dsprite programs are shared with menus/debug/UI. Suppressing program3would remove developer text and other sprites.
Do not expose raw shader indices, generic125F00selectors or resource/state getters as writes.
Gamma/color-vision setters are understood, but persistence and restore ownership should be designed with native settings rather than a competing continuous override.
